fact: On 10 November 2025 in Conakry, the West African Network of National Backbones (ROA-BN), created in December 2024, inaugurated its headquarters at Guinea's SOGEB with delegations from seven countries, Senegal and Ghana joining, to interconnect their national backbones.
title: ROA-BN : une nouvelle ère pour la coopération numérique ouest-africaine pose ses bases à Conakry
